chunks: And He made me blessed wherever I was, and He enjoined upon me prayer and zakat as long as I lived.
ai.seo_question: What did God enjoin upon Prophet Yahya regarding his worship and charity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the perpetual blessedness (barakah) of Prophet Yahya, linking his spiritual authority to the continuous practice of Salah and Zakat as pillars of his prophetic mission. The phrase 'wherever I was' is interpreted by scholars to denote his presence and influence across all times and places, reinforcing the enduring nature of divine commandments for the faithful.
